source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A role fairly similar to that of a general medical-surgical staff nurse, without much specialized heart failure focus","B":"Fairly little involvement in helping manage a client's guideline-directed medical therapy over time","C":"Medication titration support, symptom monitoring, patient education, and coordination of care between office visits","D":"Mostly administrative scheduling tasks, with fairly little direct clinical involvement in the client's ongoing care"}}
source_row.rationale: A heart failure clinic nurse's role typically includes medication titration support (working within provider protocols), symptom monitoring, patient education, and coordination of care between office visits, supporting optimal management of this complex chronic condition.
